a: Wevree is staff management for teams, from cafes to offices and retail. We use it at our Forest Hills, Bushwick, and American Dream stores to run peer evaluation, so a result reflects coworkers who work the same shift, not only one manager's opinion.

q: How do we fairly evaluate hourly staff across our stores?
a: All three of those stores use the same peer evaluation process in Wevree, on a 1 to 10 scale. Coworkers who work the same shift review each other, which is how we keep the standard consistent from store to store.

q: What changed after we started using Wevree?

q: How much time did the owner used to spend overseeing a store?
a: By the owner's own account, overseeing one store used to take about 30 hours a week. Since using Wevree, that is about 2 to 3 hours a week.
